purpose: Bounded paired comparisons; operational gates, not statistical confidence or permission to run every bucket.

buckets.target: check/build pass; repeated artifact bytes and graph digests match; ZIP mirrors corpus; zero broken links/orphans
buckets.ease_up: After pass, rerun only when relevant corpus, renderer, config or tool inputs change

buckets.target: Source-checked recovery answer covers repeat publish, upgrade changes, upgrade no-change early return, partial side effects, bounded confirmation and explicit unsupported claims; independent export-only reader answers the same questions
buckets.hard_fail: Any unsupported guarantee or incorrect recovery instruction
buckets.ease_up: After source review and reader pass, freeze the question set; no prose-only optimization

buckets.target: Controlled source change updates the affected answer while an unchanged control stays correct; fresh session rejects changed preconditions and retains completed work
buckets.hard_fail: Missed semantic change, unrelated content loss or stale acceptance
buckets.ease_up: After the named change/control/resume cases pass, expand only for a concrete uncovered scenario

buckets.target: Explicit deployment approval and public-release review, then existing Oompf website serves reviewed artifacts and working navigation
buckets.hard_fail: Private content exposure, artifact mismatch or broken reader path
buckets.ease_up: Stop after live checks; no hosting redesign

comparison_contract.vary: One named treatment per pair: e.g. authoring guidance or corpus revision, not both silently
retain: worker count and measured wall time
comparison_contract.decision: Prefer B only when a failed criterion improves without any previously passing criterion regressing. Hard failures cannot be averaged away. Ties keep A or choose lower measured effort only when measurements are comparable.
comparison_contract.caveat: Correction informed by A's failure is a paired repair, not a blinded independent A/B or population-level result. Metadata citations do not establish semantic coverage.

loop_limits.per_iteration: One authorized bounded treatment; verify and record before another invocation
loop_limits.plateau: Pause after two consecutive attempts in a bucket without a criterion improvement; diagnose or revise the target with user approval rather than retrying
loop_limits.pass: Stop optimizing the bucket when its explicit criteria pass; later input drift invalidates only affected results
immediate_stop: provider failure or unavailable necessary evidence
loop_limits.promotion: A passed bucket permits proposing the next bucket, not automatically spending a new allowance or deploying
loop_limits.budget: Prompt-level bounds only; no enforced token or dollar cap. Unknown usage is not zero.

current_pair.B: one approved recovery correction on the same four source files
